thread:
Sam: Hey team — we need a short design review for the API auth changes + SDK auth v2 + Console UX for the new key rotation flow. 30–45m. Goal is to land the RFC and agree on migration UX, rollout plan, and perf checklist. Pre-read below.

Sam: Proposed times (PST/ET): Wed 9:30am / Wed 1:30pm / Thu 10:00am. Pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite. Prefer host from platform or eng-ux.

Anya: Thu 10:00am works for me. Prefer 45m so we can walk the Console mockups.

Ryan: Wed 1:30pm is rough for me — in sprint planning. Thu 10 could be fine.

Kate: I can do Wed 9:30 if we must, but Thu 10 is ideal. Also can host if Sam is busy.

Priya: Thu 10:00am +1. Quick ask: add migration guide drafts and the security checklist to pre-read.

Sam: Yup — added links: https://redwood.docs/rfc/auth-v2 (RFC draft), https://githb.com/redwood/integration/pr/482 (SDK PR), https://notion.redwood/console-key-rotation (Console mocks + checklist).

Sam: Quick pre-read checklist (please skim before the call):
```
- Read RFC: goals, migration strategy (2–3 mins)
- Review SDK PR: breaking changes, client API examples (2–3 mins)
- Console mocks: user flow + error states (2 mins)
- Security checklist: KMS integration, rotation window, audit events (1–2 mins)
- Rollout plan draft: canary %, fallback, telemetry (1 min)
```

Anya: Small ask — can we add a short eval plan (prompts + perf targets) to the rollout doc? I'll paste a template after this.

Priya: Also pinging @security on the checklist — want to make sure HSM/KMS notes are covered.

Sam: Good call. Priya, can you run the security ping and summarise comments before Thu?

Priya: Yup, I’ll do that.

Calendar-bot: Tentative event created: "API Auth v2 + SDK + Console: Design Review" Thu 10:00–10:45 PST (attendees TBD) — link: https://calendar.redwood/events/abc123

Ryan: Ok Thu 10 works. Can we get a quick code-owner list attached? I can add mine for runtime and routing.

Sam: Adding code owners to the agenda: runtime (Ryan), sdk (Anya), console (Kate), security (Priya). Also adding a brief QA/metrics owner for rollout (Ben? — @kate can you confirm?).

Kate: I’ll reach out to Ben. If he can’t make the meeting, I’ll bring his metrics checklist.

Sam: Agenda for the call (30–45m):
- 0–5m: Goals + quick context (Sam)
- 5–15m: RFC highlights + migration constraints (Ryan)
- 15–30m: SDK changes + examples (Anya)
- 30–40m: Console UX walk + error states (Kate)
- 40–45m: Rollout plan & action items (Sam/Priya)

Priya: Suggestion — flip SDK and RFC sections if folks want more time on the migration strategy.

Sam: Good point. I'll rearrange if several people vote for that. Reply with "swap" if you prefer SDK earlier.

Anya: swap

Ryan: swap

Kate: keep as-is (need to see RFC before SDK)

Sam: Split vote — I'll default to the original order since Kate needs RFC first. If Kate shares a one-paragraph summary before the call we can move SDK earlier.

Sam: Action items before Thu 10:00: final RFC link (Sam), SDK PR annotated (Anya), Console mocks updated with error flows (Kate), security review ping (Priya), metrics checklist from Ben (Kate).

Priya: I’ll post security comments by EOD Wed.

Anya: I’ll add annotated examples to the PR by Wed noon.

Kate: Will update mocks and confirm Ben by EOD Wed.

Sam: Thanks all. I’ll confirm and lock the event by EOD. Ping me if your availability changes. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
